page_title: LEI 2-0 IPS | Leicester v Ipswich 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90+2' The referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
90+2' Leif Davis (Ipswich) scores a goal, but Andrew Kitchen makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand.
90+1' Leif Davis (Ipswich) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
88' It's time for a substitution. Massimo Luongo (Ipswich) comes on in place of Samy Morsy.
88' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Wilfred Ndidi as he is replaced by Oliver Skipp (Leicester).
88' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
84' Wow, what an escape. Jeremy Monga (Leicester) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
80' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to substitute Jamie Vardy and he is replaced by Patson Daka (Leicester).
80' Substitution. Jake Evans (Leicester) has come on for Kasey McAteer.

78' Omari Hutchinson plays the ball through to Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) on the edge of the box, he turns and shoots but it's a fraction wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
77' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Liam Delap (Ipswich) heads on.
77' A quickly taken corner by Leicester.

76' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Now Leicester have a corner.
71' Kieran McKenna has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) replacing Julio Enciso.
71' Substitution. Jack Clarke will be replaced by Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich).
71' Substitution. Jens Cajuste is replaced by Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
71' The referee signals a substitution. Liam Delap (Ipswich) is brought on as a substitute for George Hirst.
69' 2 - 0 It’s a GOAL! It looked impossible to score from that angle, but Kasey McAteer (Leicester) somehow finds the net with a cheeky shot past the keeper from close in.
68' George Hirst (Ipswich) races onto a cross inside the box and lets fly with a powerful effort, but Jakub Stolarczyk makes a fantastic reaction save to deny him.
64' Ruud van Nistelrooy decides to make a substitution. Jordan Ayew will be replaced by Jeremy Monga (Leicester).
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ricardo Pereira (Leicester) will replace James Justin.
64' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!

63' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Alex Palmer pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
63' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
61' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Palmer makes a comfortable save.
61' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Julio Enciso (Ipswich) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

57' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Omari Hutchinson, but his close-range header slips just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
56' A thunderous effort from long range by Julio Enciso (Ipswich) goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
53' This shall not pass! Jack Clarke (Ipswich) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.

52' Great solo effort by Julio Enciso (Ipswich) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Jakub Stolarczyk is alert and denies him.
50' James Justin (Leicester) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
46' What was Kasey McAteer (Leicester) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Andrew Kitchen has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

45' Leif Davis (Ipswich) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger. The ball is out of play and Ipswich manage to earn a corner.
44' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) is penalised for holding. Andrew Kitchen signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Ipswich.
42' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) controls a cross from Leif Davis inside the box, but sidefoots the ball just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
41' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Jack Clarke (Ipswich) takes it short.

41' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him. The ball goes out for a corner. Ipswich can continue in their attacking effort.
40' Leif Davis (Ipswich) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

39' Poor challenge! Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) is penalised for tripping and Andrew Kitchen blows his whistle. Ipswich win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
36' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

32' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. Leicester force their opponents to concede a corner.
28' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! James Justin laid the ball off to Jamie Vardy (Leicester), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
27' Leif Davis finds Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) inside the box with a nice lofted pass, but he balloons the shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
26' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

23' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
22' Andrew Kitchen interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jacob Greaves (Ipswich). Leicester have a free kick.

21' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
18' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Samy Morsy (Ipswich) but poses no threat.

18' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
15' Luke Thomas (Leicester) trips an opposition player and Andrew Kitchen signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Ipswich.
15' Ipswich keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
9' Leif Davis (Ipswich) sprays a pass out to Jack Clarke, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
8' Leif Davis (Ipswich) is angry with himself. The ball breaks to him but he hits the left post!
4' George Hirst (Ipswich) meets a cross inside the box, but Jakub Stolarczyk wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
1' The linesman signals that George Hirst (Ipswich) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' Ipswich will kick the game off.
1' The first half has just begun.
Andrew Kitchen is introduced as the referee for today's match.
